subject: Bluecrest: portal enrollment and evidence bundling plan
messages:
From: Ellie Brown <ellie.brown@bluecrest.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Bluecrest portal onboarding / SIG package request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — Bluecrest is ready to get their SIG/CAIQ profile set up in Vendr (we currently have a partial Whistic export but want the canonical record in Vendr). Attaching our formal request and the initial questionnaire PDF (Bluecrest_SIG_Request.pdf). High-level asks:

- Get us an invite to the Vendr portal and the onboarding checklist
- Confirm which evidence items we can upload vs. which you (Redwood) will provide (SOC 2 extracts, KMS attestations, SSO screenshots)
- Timeline: target completion in 3 weeks to align with procurement PO issuance

Questions for you: do you prefer a staged approach (critical CAIQ fields first, then SOC 2 artifacts) or a single intake? Also — we need an SSO contact looped for service account provisioning.

Can you share a mutual action plan? I can loop in procurement once we have dates.

Thanks,
Ellie Brown
Head of Vendor Risk, Bluecrest Financial
ellie.brown@bluecrest.com
Attachment: Bluecrest_SIG_Request.pdf (PDF, 234KB)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Brown <ellie.brown@bluecrest.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Bluecrest portal onboarding / SIG package request

Hi Ellie — great to meet you over email.

Staged approach makes sense for headline-driven procurements: start with CAIQ core fields + SOC 2 summary and then follow with deeper artifacts (network diagrams, KMS rotation logs, config screenshots). Proposed rough plan below:

1) Week 0 (this week): Vendr invite + mutual action plan (MAP) and single-point SSO contact
2) Week 1: CAIQ core completion (Q1–Q60), SOC 2 cover letter + control matrix spreadsheet (we will provide SOC 2 extracts and a signed cover)
3) Week 2: Artifact uploads — KMS proof, temp creds / presign examples, sample syslog manifests
4) Week 3: Final QA and evidence handoff, procurement signoff

Action items for Bluecrest: confirm Vendr admin(s) and SSO delegation email.
Action items for Redwood (Marissa / Mina): I will coordinate the SOC 2 extracts and a short control mapping doc. Marissa, Mina — can you confirm availability for a 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 11am ET?

If that schedule works I'll send the Vendr invite (support@vendr.com will handle portal provisioning).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head — Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Please reply with short availability for the 30-min kickoff (proposed 2026-08-10 11:00 ET). I'll create a calendar invite and include Vendr support if needed.

Thanks — K
